heading: Tuesday, April 30, 2024
topLine: Kevin Buzzard opens EPSRC-funded project to formalize Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean.

items.headline: Kevin Buzzard opens EPSRC-funded project to formalize Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean
items.summary: Kevin Buzzard (Imperial College London) announced that the open-source project to formalize a modern proof of Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean was open to contributors. The first goal was to reduce FLT to results known by the end of the 1980s, following a route planned with Richard Taylor. The project is human-led and funded by the EPSRC for five years, to September 2029.
